title: CE Skill Iteration Log
description: Schema for references/iteration-log.json - the append-only record of bugs, papercuts, drift, and fixes spotted across runs of a CE skill. Read at the start of every run to surface known issues to the agent. Never written at runtime; entries are added post-run by humans or proposed by scripts/diff_against_template.py.

_meta.description: Metadata about the log file itself.

skill_name.description: Kebab-case name matching the skill folder. A leading pipeline-stage prefix segment may carry uppercase letters (pod-2A-entity-research, pod-3B-n-gram-table, pod-4A-ros-template). Accepts {{ALL_CAPS_PLACEHOLDER}} for templates.

schema_version.description: Schema version this log conforms to.

created.description: ISO date the log was initialized. Accepts {{ALL_CAPS_PLACEHOLDER}} for templates.

last_archived.description: ISO date the most recent archive cut was made (resolved/old entries moved to references/iteration-log-archive-{YYYY-Q#}.json).

entries.description: Append-only list of iteration log entries. Newest at the bottom; never reorder.

id.description: ID format YYYY-MM-DD-NNN with NNN as a zero-padded daily counter (001, 002, ...).

category.description: What kind of issue this is.

description.description: What went wrong - one to a few sentences.

resolution.description: What fixed it (or what the proposed fix is). Optional for open / proposed entries.

fix_in_version.description: Version where the fix landed, or 'pending'.

status.description: Lifecycle state. 'proposed' = surfaced by diff_against_template.py awaiting human sign-off. 'open' = human-confirmed, awaiting fix. 'in-progress' = fix being authored. 'resolved' = fixed. 'wontfix' = closed without fix.

spotted_in_run.description: Optional pointer to the run / workspace iteration where this was spotted (e.g., 'iteration-3/eval-2/with_skill').

spotted_by.description: Who spotted it (operator handle, 'fold-back-loop', etc.). Stripped on --fork.

spotted_on.description: ISO date the issue was spotted.
